# Longevity One

> Longevity One is a luxury preventive medicine center in Tbilisi, Georgia, dedicated to the art of living longer. We measure each person's biological age and build personalized, data-driven strategies to extend healthy years through advanced diagnostics and evidence-based longevity medicine.

The site is bilingual. Georgian (ka) is the default and is served without a URL prefix; English (en) is served under the /en path. Canonical host is https://www.longevityone.ge.

Key facts:
- Category: Preventive medicine center (longevity clinic)
- Location: 4a Tamarashvili St, Tbilisi, Georgia
- Phone: +995 511 70 88 88
- Email: info@longevityone.ge
- Hours: Daily 09:00-21:00
- Languages: Georgian, English
- Founded by five Georgian physicians

Core diagnostics and technologies: PNOE metabolic analysis, TrueDiagnostic biological age testing, Enbiosis microbiome testing, VO2 Max assessment, IHHT (intermittent hypoxic-hyperoxic therapy), red light therapy.

## Main pages (English)

- [Home](https://www.longevityone.ge/en): Overview of the clinic, biological age measurement, and personalized longevity programs.
- [About](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/about): The clinic's philosophy and the five founding physicians.
- [Advisory Board](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/about/advisory-board): The scientific advisory board.
- [Services](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/services): Three pillars - managing biological age, optimizing metabolism, and peak physical performance.
- [Technologies](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/technologies): Diagnostic technologies including VO2 Max, biological age, and microbiome testing.
- [Journey](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/journey): The 8-stage patient journey from digital onboarding through 12 weeks of micro-coaching.
- [Packages & Pricing](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/packages): Personalized longevity programs, with health assessments starting from 550 GEL.
- [Team](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/team): The clinic's physicians and their credentials.
- [Corporate](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/corporate): Corporate wellness and executive health programs.
- [Blog](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/blog): Articles on longevity, biological age, metabolism, and preventive medicine.
- [FAQ](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/faq): Answers about services, tests, programs, and pricing.
- [Contact](https://www.longevityone.ge/en/contact): Address, phone, and opening hours.
